changes.original_quote: Sarvottam Cables Ltd hereby informs that it has received an order from the office of the Joint Commissioner, CGST, Mumbai, raising a demand of **₹46.3 crore** (including interest and penalty) relating to input tax credit claimed for FY20-21 and FY2021-22.
changes.source_paragraph: Sarvottam Cables Ltd hereby informs that it has received an order from the office of the Joint Commissioner, CGST, Mumbai, raising a demand of **₹46.3 crore** (including interest and penalty) relating to input tax credit claimed for FY2020-21 and FY2021-22.
